units.translation: The mighty oracle of Loxias will not betray you.
But when he is dead, never betray him.
Envious pain creeps upon the champions of justice, the Atreidae.
of Hecate, whose statues were customarily placed before houses (in the scholia on Theocritus 2, 36)
where all the manuscripts except one have πρόδρομος [running before], as also in Aristides vol. 1 p. 17, 1 ed. Jebb. For other examples see the Thesaurus vol. 6 p. 1682.
Mistress Hecate, before the royal halls.
For I have learned to hate traitors.
the slavish sandal, a covering for the foot
This great host of horsemen flows forth as a vanguard.
I came as a forerunner to the ancient images of the gods.
He had prophesied beforehand what was to be accomplished.
to be eager or ready to act
where now προμηθεῖσθαι [to take forethought] has been restored, which the scholiast reads
In being eager and daring, what penalty do you see present?
Since he is eager, it is necessary to speak.
Since you are eager, I will not oppose.
For you lack nothing in eagerness.
Soon all-fulfilling time will pass the vestibule of the house.
to hurl forth, a Homeric word
For to hurl the wretched ancient city to Hades.
Proetides, name of a Theban gate
Proetides, name of a Theban gate, on which see Unger, Theb. Parad. vol. 1 p. 297 ff.
Μαλα προ μαλις ορτα σιβε συσχεπτα εχπ. Τοδτιυς Χομμεντ. π. 32. Τερτιυμ εχασμπλυμ λατερε βιδετυρ εν βερσυ χορρυπτο
υβι δυβιτατυμ εστ υτρυμ πρόκακα παθών [having suffered very evil things] αν, θυο μινυς προβαβιλε, προκακοπαθῶν [suffering evil beforehand] σκριβενδυμ σιτ.
You speak very evil things against the noble Persians.
speaking unforgettable, hateful, very evil things

He sailed from the soft-woven veils.

Thus Hermann for τῶν πρόμαρπτι κάμνοις [you would toil for the seizer], from the scholiast's note πρότερον θάνοις, ὦ μάρ-πτι, πρὶν ἡμᾶς συλλαβεῖν [may you die first, O seizer, before seizing us]. Not much weight should be given to the scholiast, since he interprets the most corrupt passages in this ode.
Do not toil beforehand at this shepherd's task.
Before, O seizer, may you toil.
you would toil for the seizer
